[1/5] Loop guard: drop same-tool stagnation, keep domain ids (ADR-050). [2/5] Guardrails: outputs-only redaction, narrower assignment rule. [3/5] Kernel: worst-component pressure up to 40 points. [4/5] Simulation manifest catalogue and dangling bridges; memory confidence recompute lifecycle; research persist/dedupe/cache cap; skill id validation; budget cap validation; timeout=0 and shared budget charges (ADR-051, ADR-052). [5/5] Tests, gates, commit and push.

impact_assessment.why: The last five pushes introduced controls with false positives and state drift; the review found ten concrete defects.
impact_assessment.benefits: Normal agent work is no longer aborted or rewritten, one failing subsystem can degrade the kernel, evidence confidence stays consistent, and research persistence is idempotent.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: timeout=0 semantics restored, guard behavior narrowed; dependency: none; concurrency: confidence recompute stays inside the write lock; state: links are removed on memory deletion.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Every correction has a failing-first test; no safety default was relaxed, only false-positive paths were removed.

[1/3] Link-aware recall: one-hop accepted supports/derived_from promotion in vector and keyword search, provenance in via_links, active/unarchived/unexpired guard, configurable recall_link_boost (ADR-055). [2/3] Tests and README. [3/3] Gates, commit and push.

impact_assessment.why: The evidence graph was not used at recall time; corroborating memories were invisible unless their text matched.
impact_assessment.benefits: Recall surfaces supported facts with provenance, bounded and local, without changing stored confidence.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ranking changes when recall_link_boost > 0; dependency: none; concurrency: one read query per recall; state: none written.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default 0.5 is bounded, 0 is a no-op, and only accepted supporting links from active records count.
